spoken_summary: Donald Trump states that crime numbers are "way down" to unprecedented levels and that he and others feel very safe. He thanks the audience, presumably law enforcement and military personnel, calling them "incredible people" who "make the country run." He promises that D.C. will become the "best capital ever" and will look better than it ever has.

central_claim: Donald Trump is taking credit for making Washington D.C. safer and is thanking law enforcement and the National Guard for their role in this achievement.
